compose_variable_semantics.source: Typel et al., CompOSE Reference Manual v3.01 (2022), arXiv:2203.03209; cross-checked against repo implementation python_frontend/compose_eos/eos_data.py:94-118 and fortran_eos/src/compose_eos_types.f90:118-143 and docs/NS_COWLING_PHYSICS_AND_CODE_GUIDE_V4.md:25
compose_variable_semantics.units: n_B [fm^-3], P, eps, F per volume [MeV fm^-3], m_n c^2, m_p c^2, mu [MeV], Q1 [MeV], Q2..Q7 dimensionless
compose_variable_semantics.Q2: entropy per baryon (must be 0 for cold T=0)
compose_variable_semantics.Q3: mu_B / m_n - 1 for Il=1 (barotropic enthalpy derivative gauge); for Il=0 Q3 stores mu_B/m_n - 1 - Yq*Q4 (charge-shifted)
compose_variable_semantics.Q4: mu_Q / m_n  (charge chemical potential, mu_Q = mu_p - mu_n)
compose_variable_semantics.Q5: mu_lepton / m_n  (per-CompOSE the included lepton potential)
compose_variable_semantics.Q6: F / m_n - 1  (free energy per baryon, includes rest mass)
compose_variable_semantics.Q7: eps / (n_B m_n) - 1  (energy density per baryon, includes rest mass)
compose_variable_semantics.Il: lepton-content flag; all 18 sources in this cohort are Il=1, Yq=0
compose_variable_semantics.cold_identity: T=0, beta-equilibrium, no trapped leptons => Q2=0, Q5=0 (for Il=1), Q6=Q7, mu_B = F + P/n_B

observed_in_cohort.Q6_minus_Q7: 0 for all 18 models (exact in stored precision)
observed_in_cohort.Q5: APR/BBB/GM/GPPVA/SPG = 0; RG_SLY4=1.383e-3, RG_KDE0v1=6.035e-4 constant => beta_equilibrated=False (this is the true cause of the 156 M7 rejections, NOT a mass issue)

mass_conventions_observed.consequence: Every crust-core pair in the 65-pair matrix carries a different rest-mass convention between crust and core; dmcr ranges from +0.56533 (GPPVA 939 family) to +1.56533 MeV (TM1e).

gauge_alignment_derivation.name: CompOSE normalization with unchanged physical thermodynamics
definition: For a pure re-encoding, (1+Q3_out)*mn_out=(1+Q3_src)*mn_src; matcher Euler re-derivation is disclosed separately.
gauge_alignment_derivation.what_it_is: A dimensionless representation change only. Each source is decoded with its own mass reference, and the physical EOS is encoded with the output reference.
gauge_alignment_derivation.what_it_is_NOT: No constituent-mass correction, no additive rest-energy shift, no reconciliation of different microscopic Hamiltonians, and no proof that mismatched source model masses are scientifically interchangeable.
invariants_preserved: n_B, P, F, epsilon and mu_Q on retained source rows
The physical P(epsilon) and sound speed of retained source branches are unchanged by mass-reference re-encoding.
Matching physical output and chosen endpoints are invariant under consistent re-encoding of an identical input EOS with another normalization reference.
gauge_alignment_derivation.provider_euler_correction: The matcher continues to re-derive output Q3 from F+Q1. This may repair a provider Euler residual and is distinct from normalization. The maximum retained-source residual remains reported.
gauge_alignment_derivation.rejected_previous_argument: If epsilon_new=epsilon+n*dm, then (cs_new/c)^2=(dP/dn)/(d epsilon/dn+dm), which differs from (cs/c)^2 for dm!=0. Preserving dF/dn alone does not preserve gravitating energy or sound speed.

report_compatibility.dm_mass_gauge_meV: Legacy field now reports the applied physical energy-per-baryon shift, always zero. It is not the difference of normalization references.

forbidden_cases: No physical species-mass correction without source-backed composition and equilibrium recalculation.
Native sharp Maxwell mass-pair gate remains unchanged; this correction does not bypass it.
No changes to raw EOS sources.

fortran: Decode source F and chemical potentials with source mn; remove additive dmcr from window search, bridge endpoints and retained crust rows.
Applied physical-energy-shift report field is zero.
Require finite thermodynamic metadata and enforce existing Q5 beta-equilibrium bound even if a caller supplies beta_equilibrated=true.
python: Reference matcher no longer shifts physical energies using header differences.
implementation_changes_this_phase.tests: python_frontend/tests/test_mass_normalization_contract.py adds re-encoding invariance across all five exposed native methods and independent Python source-energy preservation.

acceptance.maxwell_mass_gate: PRESERVED verbatim (1e-12 relative, neutron and proton checked independently)
acceptance.gate_weakening: NONE (no tolerance was widened to make any pair pass)

supersedes.defect: The prior additive F/mu/epsilon transformation was incorrectly labelled representation-only and sound-speed invariant. Historical receipts retain their original interpretation and must be recomputed before reuse.
